purpose.en: Exercise one explicit user-assigned real task.
purpose.zh: 执行用户单独指定的真实任务。

owner.zh: 用户指定的验收智能体

entry.en: Integrated engineering delivery and an explicit acceptance assignment
entry.zh: 集成工程交付完成且已指定验收任务

exit.en: The assigned scenario has an honest result and remaining limits.
exit.zh: 指定场景有明确结果，保留限制如实报告。

failure.en: Diagnose the failing stage and enter scoped repair.
failure.zh: 定位失败阶段，再进入范围内修复。

boundary.en: Install or launch alone does not authorize UI inspection, real Agent work or publication.
boundary.zh: 安装或启动本身不授权界面检查、真实智能体任务或发布。
